title: Learning a New Skill at Thirty
paragraphs: At thirty-two years old, Marwan decides to learn graphic design after work, something he never studied in school but has always found interesting whenever he sees good design online.
He worries at first that he is too old to start something completely new, especially watching younger students learn faster during the same online course he enrolled in a few weeks ago.

During the second week, he almost quits after a particularly frustrating lesson on color theory, but a supportive comment from another student in the course discussion encourages him to keep going a little longer.
After three months of steady practice, Marwan completes his first real project for a small business. He learns that starting late is still far better than never starting something meaningful at all.
